title: Effect of Surgical Smoke on Air Quality
brief_summary: This study; It was planned to (1) determine the effect of surgical smoke on indoor air quality and (2) examine its effect on physical symptoms and throat culture results in operating room employees and compare it with those working in internal units.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Health workers in operating room

Exclusion Criteria:

* those with chronic diseases such as Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease, Asthma
